name: john
highlights: --single-user-seed — Wordlist with seeds per username (user:password[s] format)
--single-pair-max — Override max. number of word pairs generated (6)
--rules-skip-nop — Skip any NOP ":" rules (you already ran w/o rules)
--loopback[ — Like --wordlist, but extract words from a .pot file
--mem-file-size — Size threshold for wordlist preload (default 2048 MB)
--dupe-suppression — Suppress all dupes in wordlist (and force preload)
